title: A nonzero normalized classical lisse sheaf has an anchor eigenvalue
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{k_0}$ and distinct coefficient prime $\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-punctual-weights]. Let $X_0$ be a nonempty geometrically connected separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $A$ be a normalized classical Weil realization [def-zl-normalized-classical-weil-realization], and $S$ a classical lisse $\Omega$-Weil sheaf whose underlying classical carrier is not zero [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. For every closed point $x$ of $X_0$, there exists $\alpha\in\Omega$ with $\operatorname{SfPunctualEigenvalue}(A(S),x,\alpha)$, using the actual finite-stage local operators of [def-weil-punctual-weights]. No curve, weight, purity, or eigenvalue nonvanishing hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Geometric connectedness makes $X$ connected. Separated finite-type base change and finite type over a field make it separated and Noetherian [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change; lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. The coefficient prime is invertible since it differs from the characteristic. By [lem-kun-closed-point-field], the closed residue field is finite over $k_0$, hence embeds into $k$ over $k_0$, giving a geometric lift of the anchor. Apply the algebraic-coefficient fibre equivalence of [cor-galois-lisse-representations] at that lift. Its composite with the faithful representation-forgetful functor reflects zero objects: if the underlying fibre were zero, the identity of the representation and hence of the classical sheaf would be zero. Thus the carrier being nonzero gives a nonzero finite-dimensional classical fibre.

proof.text: Apply [lem-zl-classical-local-frobenius-iterate-comparison] to $A$ at this geometric lift and at the positive degree of the anchor. Its normalized fibre isomorphism intertwines the recorded classical operator with the realization local operator. In particular the normalized fibre is nonzero and finite-dimensional. No invertibility of the local endomorphism is used.

source.place: Paragraph 3: existence of an eigenvalue at the fixed anchor; expanded step 1 of lem-zl-anchored-pure-curve-criterion.

proof.text: Descend the realized Weil object, its structure isomorphism, its inverse and their equations to one finite coefficient field by [lem-wf-common-stage-weil-iterate]. The point pullback and scalar cohomology comparisons in [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres] identify its normalized degree-zero fibre with the scalar extension of this finite-stage fibre. Under the normalized scalar comparisons, each factor of local Frobenius (iterated point transport, semilinear return comparison, and iterated Weil map) is the scalar extension of the corresponding finite-stage factor; transport naturality [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural] and the prescribed pullback/scalar comparisons give the intertwining of their composites. Consequently the scalar-extended finite-stage local endomorphism has a nonzero finite-dimensional space. Apply [lem-zl-alg-closed-endomorphism-eigenvalue] to it. The resulting eigenvalue, the same finite model and its Weil isomorphism, and the residue embedding witness exactly [def-weil-punctual-weights]. This proves existence only, before any purity or nonvanishing argument.

lean.statement: theorem classicalRealized_anchor_eigenvalue (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) (Ω : Type (u + 1)) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω] (X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom] [Nonempty X₀.left] [GeometricallyConnected X₀.hom] (A : @ZlClassicalRealization D l _ hl Ω _ _ _ X₀ _ _ _ (⟨fun x ↦ @isUnit_of_invertible _ _ _ (zlClassicalStalkInvertible D l hl X₀ x)⟩)) (S : @ZlClassicalWeil D l _ Ω _ _ _ X₀ _ _ _ (⟨fun x ↦ @isUnit_of_invertible _ _ _ (zlClassicalStalkInvertible D l hl X₀ x)⟩)) (hne : ¬ IsZero S.carrier) (anchor : {x : X₀.left // x ∈ closedPoints X₀.left}) : ∃ α : Ω, SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Ω X₀ ((@ZlClassicalRealization.weil D l _ hl Ω _ _ _ X₀ _ _ _ (⟨fun x ↦ @isUnit_of_invertible _ _ _ (zlClassicalStalkInvertible D l hl X₀ x)⟩) A).obj S) anchor α
